summary: Filename-only Title Case changes extension casing when removing the entire stem of a .TXT filename.

judgment.rationale: The mode boundary is lost before formatting: Renaming.cpp builds the full filename first, then Helpers.cpp interprets it as a filesystem path. An empty stem turns .TXT into a dotfile-shaped input with no extension, so Title Case can alter those characters. Preserve the extension separately through the transform.
evidence: The live report reproduces the scope leak with foo.TXT, Filename only, Search=foo, empty Replace, and Title Case; preview/apply changes the extension to .Txt.

At PowerToys main commit 084281ef6b137aa47a1e6a8e1e7bf79b0fe0378e, Renaming.cpp reattaches the original extension before calling GetTransformedFileName; Helpers.cpp then parses the combined string using filesystem stem/extension rules.
PR #51982 remains open/changes-requested and does not change the NameOnly extension ordering for existing Title Case/Capitalize modes.
The upstream issue is open with no comments; no fork issue or PR mirror for 52209 was found by repository search.
PR #51982 author comment on 2026-11-18 says the new Unicode helper is available for other casing paths in separate fixes; the current diff still scopes its use to SentenceCase.
judgment.recommended_action: Approve or revise the focused design before implementation.

fix_assessment.rationale: The open linked PR #51982 does not cover this existing PowerRename path; no separate upstream fix or fork mirror was found.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep Filename only formatting scoped to the stem
proposed_fixes.root_cause: For NameOnly, DoRename reattaches the original extension to the replacement before calling GetTransformedFileName. When the replacement stem is empty, the resulting .TXT is parsed as a dotfile with no extension, so Title Case transforms the extension as part of the stem and changes it to .Txt.
plan: Keep the original extension as a separate value throughout NameOnly formatting rather than reattaching it before generic path parsing.
Apply the requested text transformation only to the replacement stem, then append the original extension verbatim after the transform.
Add regression tests for an empty replacement stem with an uppercase extension under Title Case and Capitalize Each Word, plus non-empty stems and extension-only controls.
verification: Run focused PowerRename native tests for NameOnly and GetTransformedFileName.
Verify foo.TXT with Filename only, Search=foo, empty Replace, and Title Case previews .TXT unchanged in extension casing and Apply preserves that extension exactly.

confidence.rationale: The issue has an exact reproducible sequence and the current source ordering accounts for the dotfile edge case; a focused stem/extension separation has limited scope.
